title: althaea agrigentina
intro: Althaea agrigentina, commonly known as the Sardinian marshmallow, is a plant species belonging to the Malvaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in soothing digestive issues and promoting wound healing, thanks to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Althaea agrigentina include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce inflammation and protect cells from damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include mucilages, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
